metadata.title: Microsoft CodePush alternative for Capacitor
metadata.description: App Center CodePush is retired. Compare Capgo for Capacitor, Ionic, and Cordova live updates, and EAS for Expo and React Native.

blocks.text: For teams that shipped over-the-air updates with App Center CodePush. Microsoft retired App Center, including CodePush, on March 31, 2025.
Capacitor, Ionic, or Cordova app: move to Capgo for hosted live updates with channels and rollback. React Native app: Capgo is not the fit; use EAS Update or self-host the archived server.
14-day unlimited free trial. No credit card required.
Capgo vs Microsoft CodePush at a glance
Capgo vs Microsoft CodePush, as of September 2026. Each Microsoft CodePush fact links to a numbered source listed below the table.
